instruction: Candid full shot of an indoor gym with grey mats. On the left, the man in the white t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands in a defensive stance, blocking a kick. On the right, the man in the grey t-shirt and black shorts (R2) leans far back on his left leg, extending a high right kick toward R1's torso. In the background, several bystanders in casual athletic wear observe the session. The scene is brightly lit by overhead lights with a neutral color palette.
